title: Rc Macos Arm64
objective: Build and validate a relocatable unsigned macOS arm64 release candidate on m1, separating unsigned validation from credential-gated signing and notarization.

handoff.summary: Added a credential-free unsigned macOS release-candidate path while preserving the Developer ID, installer, notarization, and publication path. The release command rejects dynamically non-relocatable Homebrew Node builders, validates ad-hoc signatures, creates and checksums a ZIP, then tests its extracted executables from a fresh home/cache and records exact builder, archive, Mach-O, content, and cold/warm benchmark provenance. An Apple M1 Max candidate built with the official Node.js v26.5.1 arm64 distribution passed the complete SEA suite and clean-room exact-mathematics validation.
risks: The unsigned lane deliberately does not prove Developer ID signing, notarization, Gatekeeper assessment, or installer signing; those remain credential-gated release steps.
The official Node.js v26.5.1 binary sets a macOS 13.5 minimum deployment target, so this candidate does not support older macOS releases.
ZIP byte hashes may vary when input mtimes vary; the report makes this explicit and records a stable extracted-content manifest instead of claiming byte-for-byte reproducibility.
next_steps: Register test/release-macos-arm64.cjs in the shared Node test manifest during integration.
Cherry-pick the lane commit after the independently owned standalone source-tree relocation fix.
Run the preserved signed path with SageMath, Inc. Apple credentials before publishing a macOS asset.
